notes.title: New update
notes.content:
New update arrived!

This update includes:
- Multiple bug fixes
- Option menu added, which provides the ability to adjust FOV and Sprint Speed.

Thanks for playing the game and thanks to all who left a review. Without these comments it would be more difficult to find out what to improve.

This is still a small game, but now more convenient to play.

Have a good time!

notes.title: Now fully released!
notes.content:
Changes compared to [i]early access[/i] version: 

- Some small bugfixes
- Option to change mouse sensitivity
- Added 3 achievements

Enjoy!
